name: Logistics Supply Chain
description: Supply chain logistics system with shipments, carriers, and warehouse hubs. Practice complex JOINs and delivery performance analysis.

tables.name: warehouses
tables.description: Distribution hub locations with capacity information

tables.name: carriers
tables.description: Shipping carrier partners with service types and ratings

tables.name: shipments
tables.description: Shipment tracking records with origin, destination, and delivery performance

relationships.description: Each shipment originates from one warehouse hub
Each shipment is destined to one warehouse hub
Each shipment is handled by one carrier

sample_queries.title: Carrier Performance Analysis
sample_queries.description: Compare on-time delivery rates across carriers
sample_queries.sql:
SELECT 
  c.carrier_name,
  c.service_type,
  COUNT(s.tracking_no) as total_shipments,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.is_delayed = false THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as on_time_shipments,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN s.is_delayed = false THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 1) as on_time_pct,
  AVG(s.actual_days - s.est_days) as avg_delay_days
FROM carriers c
JOIN shipments s ON c.carrier_id = s.carrier_id
WHERE s.delivery_status = 'Delivered'
GROUP BY c.carrier_id, c.carrier_name, c.service_type
ORDER BY on_time_pct DESC;

sample_queries.title: Busiest Shipping Routes
sample_queries.description: Top origin-destination pairs by shipment volume
sample_queries.sql:
SELECT 
  w1.hub_name as origin,
  w1.city as origin_city,
  w2.hub_name as destination,
  w2.city as dest_city,
  COUNT(*) as shipment_count,
  SUM(s.weight_kg) as total_weight,
  SUM(s.shipping_cost_idr) as total_revenue
FROM shipments s
JOIN warehouses w1 ON s.origin_hub_id = w1.hub_id
JOIN warehouses w2 ON s.dest_hub_id = w2.hub_id
GROUP BY w1.hub_name, w1.city, w2.hub_name, w2.city
ORDER BY shipment_count DESC
LIMIT 10;

sample_queries.title: Delayed Shipments Investigation
sample_queries.description: Analyze delayed shipments by carrier and route
sample_queries.sql:
SELECT 
  c.carrier_name,
  w1.city as origin_city,
  w2.city as dest_city,
  COUNT(*) as delayed_count,
  AVG(s.actual_days - s.est_days) as avg_delay_days,
  SUM(s.shipping_cost_idr) as delayed_shipment_value
FROM shipments s
JOIN carriers c ON s.carrier_id = c.carrier_id
JOIN warehouses w1 ON s.origin_hub_id = w1.hub_id
JOIN warehouses w2 ON s.dest_hub_id = w2.hub_id
WHERE s.is_delayed = true
GROUP BY c.carrier_name, w1.city, w2.city
ORDER BY delayed_count DESC;

sample_queries.title: Warehouse Utilization
sample_queries.sql:
SELECT 
  w.hub_name,
  w.city,
  w.province,
  COUNT(DISTINCT s1.tracking_no) as outbound_shipments,
  COUNT(DISTINCT s2.tracking_no) as inbound_shipments,
  COUNT(DISTINCT s1.tracking_no) + COUNT(DISTINCT s2.tracking_no) as total_shipments
FROM warehouses w
LEFT JOIN shipments s1 ON w.hub_id = s1.origin_hub_id
LEFT JOIN shipments s2 ON w.hub_id = s2.dest_hub_id
GROUP BY w.hub_id, w.hub_name, w.city, w.province
ORDER BY total_shipments DESC;
